g.title: Entity Relationship Diagram created by erdantic

a.xlink:title:
hydromodpy.spatial.domain.depth_model_config.ConstantThicknessDepthModel
Vertical model using one constant thickness below topography.
Bottom elevation is computed cell-wise as: ``bottom = top_surface - thickness``.

hydromodpy.spatial.domain.depth_model_config.FlatSubstratumDepthModel
Vertical model using one flat (constant-elevation) substratum.
Bottom elevation is constant over the whole domain: ``bottom = substratum_elevation``.

hydromodpy.spatial.domain.domain_config.DomainConfig
Domain configuration.
Controls which zone providers are loaded in `Domain`.

hydromodpy.spatial.domain.spatial_support_config.CatchmentZonesSupportConfig
Support built from catchment/domain zonation already prepared in setup.

hydromodpy.spatial.domain.spatial_support_config.GeneratedBandsSupportConfig
Analytical bands split along one cartesian axis.

hydromodpy.spatial.domain.spatial_support_config.GeneratedRingsSupportConfig
Analytical concentric rings centered on one cartesian point.

hydromodpy.spatial.domain.spatial_support_config.GeologySupportConfig
Support backed by the geology data manager.
